title: UNDERWATER BONDING WITH A BIOBASED ADHESIVE
BIO-ADHESIVES
abstract: Distiller's Grain (DG) based bio-adhesives consisting of DG biomass, crosslinking agents, and fillers are described as substitutes for formaldehyde based wood glue for making wood panels. Algal bio-adhesives consisting of algal biomass, crosslinking agents, and fillers are described as substitutes for formaldehyde based glue for making wood panels. Processes for preparing such DG based bio- adhesives and algal bio-adhesives are provided, comprising the steps of: combining DG biomass or algal material with a cross-linking agent and inorganic fillers to form a blend; micronisation or homogenisation of the blend to obtain powdery material; and mixing the powdery material with additional water to form a bio-adhesive.

title: Bio-based adhesive composition for air laid nonwoven material
abstract: The present invention relates to an environmentally friendly, renewable, compostable and/or biodegradable bio-based adhesive composition. The bio-based composition comprises chitosan, an acid, and a plasticizer. The air laid nonwoven material treated with the bio-based adhesive of the present invention can provide an air laid nonwoven material exhibiting higher elongation (i.e., elongation at break) and strength compared to an air laid nonwoven material treated with a previously obtainable bio-based adhesive.

title: ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING BIO-BASED ADHESIVES AND MIXTURES FOR CURTAIN COATING
Preparation and application of shaving board bio-based adhesive
abstract: The invention discloses preparation and application of a shaving board bio-based adhesive, and relates to the technical field of adhesives for artificial boards, the shaving board bio-based adhesive specifically comprises the following components: a bio-based acrylate polymer, a polyfunctional isocyanate curing agent, a preservative and a flame retardant; the content of the bio-based acrylate polymer is 70 to 80 parts; the content of the polyfunctional isocyanate curing agent is 10 to 20 parts; and the content of the preservative is 1-5 parts. On the premise that the original factory production process is not changed, the hot-pressing efficiency of the artificial board is improved; meanwhile, the bio-based acrylate polymer is used as a main raw material, a small amount of polyfunctional isocyanate is used as a curing agent, the use amount of conventional isocyanate as an adhesive is reduced, and meanwhile, by designing the film forming temperature of the acrylate polymer and controlling the curing time, the wood shaving aging time can be prolonged, and the adhesive pre-curing degree can be reduced; and the pre-pressed plate blank passes through a conveyor belt transition area of the hot press in a complete form.

title: ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING BIO-BASED ADHESIVE AND MIXTURES FOR CURTAIN COATING
abstract: The present invention describes novel formaldehyde-free adhesive compositions, adhesive mixtures comprising said adhesive composition (component A) and at least one hardener agent (component B), and adhesive systems wherein the adhesive composition further comprising a thickener agent (component A) and the at least one hardener agent (component B) are isolated one of another. Said adhesive compositions, mixtures and systems may be used for curtain coating of a substrate and, in particular, for plywood manufacturing by curtain coating.The present invention also relates to a process for manufacturing a coated material by applying the adhesive mixture by curtain coating, to coated products, in particular plywood, obtainable or obtained by said process and to coated products, or plywood comprising the adhesive composition or mixture of the invention.

title: Acid and alkali resistant bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an acid and alkali resistant bio-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof. Specifically, after carboxyl-terminated hyperbranched polyester is dissolved with water, a certain amount of 1-(3-dimethylaminopropyl)-3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide are added, stirred and mixed evenly, dopamine is added, dopamine is grafted to the terminal of thecarboxyl-terminated hyperbranched polyester through amidation reaction between carboxyl at the terminal of the hyperbranched polyester and amine groups in the dopamine, tannic acid and a metal salt solution are added, pH value of a reaction system is adjusted to 9-10 by triethylamine, and the acid and alkali resistant bio-based adhesive is obtained after reaction. According to the invention, the water is mainly used as a solvent, the carboxyl-terminated hyperbranched polyester is used as a core, the dopamine is used as a branched chain, the tannic acid is used as a cross-linking agent, and metal ions are used as a cross-linking factor to prepare the bio-based adhesive which is non-toxic and pollution-free, and the bio-based adhesive has higher adhesion strength and acid and alkali resistance, and is simple in preparation method and easy to popularize.

title: BIOBASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITONS
BIOBASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF MAKING THE SAME
NATURAL ADHESIVE AGENT
abstract: PURPOSE: A natural adhesive agent and a manufacturing method thereof are provided to secure safety and environment-friendliness, and to ensure water resistance, moisture resistance, and anti-insect functions. CONSTITUTION: A method for manufacturing a natural adhesive agent comprises the steps of: pulverizing eggshells to prepare a powder; and mixing lacquer with the manufactured powder, wherein the ratio of the eggshell and lacquer is 1:1 ~ 3:7. The natural adhesive agent facilitates the molding and prevents cracks due to strong adhesive property.

title: Chemical industrial natural adhesive
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of adhesives, in particular to a chemical industrial natural adhesive. The chemical industrial natural adhesive is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: 30 to 50 parts of water, 25 to 45 parts of starch, 3 to 5 parts of animal glue, 1 to 8 parts of hide glue, 5 to 8 parts of rosin and 5 to 15 parts of asphalt. The chemical industrial natural adhesive disclosed by the invention has the beneficial effects that the storage of the adopted raw materials is rich, and the production cost is greatly reduced.

title: Full-bio-based adhesive based on epoxidized soybean oil and preparation method of full-bio-based adhesive
abstract: The invention discloses a full-bio-based adhesive based on epoxidized soybean oil and a preparation method of the full-bio-based adhesive. Specifically, according to the method, epoxidized soybean oil is taken as a reaction substrate, citric acid is taken as a nucleophilic reagent to open an epoxy ring of the epoxidized soybean oil, tannic acid is taken as a catechol-like compound to provide adhesion performance after cross-linking polymerization, and a bio-based cross-linked network structure with excellent adhesion performance is constructed. The environment-friendly adhesive is researched and developed on the basis of full bio-based raw materials, and has the remarkable characteristics of no toxicity, reproducibility, environment friendliness and the like. The adhesive adopts an efficient one-pot synthesis process, the preparation process is simple and convenient, and industrial mass production is easy to realize. And the performance is excellent, the tensile strength and long-term stability are excellent, and due to the outstanding water resistance and mildew-proof performance, the coating stands out of similar products. In addition, the product is wide in raw material source and obvious in cost advantage, and has high performance and economic benefits.

title: Preparation method of high-strength bio-based adhesive for sponge
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-strength bio-based adhesive for sponge. The method comprises the following steps of: (1) uniformly mixing and stirring curcas oil, m-chlorocinnamic acid, activated clay and propionic anhydride, and carrying out reaction treatment to obtain modified curcas oil; (2) carrying out reaction treatment on chestnut shell lignin, formaldehyde and sodium hydroxide to obtain modified lignin; and (3) uniformly mixing and stirring the modified curcas oil, the modified lignin, phenol, sodium hydroxide, barium-based lubricating grease and a flexibilizer,and carrying out reaction treatment for 30-40min in an environment of 75-85DEG C to obtain the high-strength bio-based adhesive for sponge. According to the preparation method of the high-strength bio-based adhesive for the sponge, the operation process is green and environmentally friendly, industrial continuous production can be achieved, the prepared high-strength bio-based adhesive is high inbonding strength, easy to degrade and free of corrosion, and the service life of the sponge can be effectively prolonged.

title: High strength plant-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present invention discloses a high strength plant-based adhesive, which comprises, by weight, 40-70 parts of plant modified starch, 1-3 parts of modified filler, 15-20 parts of polylactic acid, 10-15 parts of polyurethane, 5-11 parts of chlorinated paraffin, 8-13 parts of hydrogenated rosin resin, 1-3 parts of lauric acid diethanolamide, 0.8-1.5 parts of boron nitride fiber, 1-2 parts of castor oil, 0.5-1 part of a dispersant, and 1-2 parts of antioxidant. The invention further discloses a preparation method of the high strength plant-based adhesive. The prepared high strength plant-based adhesive of the present invention has characteristics of good stability, high adhesion strength, and low preparation cost.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE FOR ELECTRICAL INSULATION
Full-bio-based adhesive as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a full-bio-based adhesive as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The full-bio-based adhesive is particularly suitable for the wood product manufacturing industry. According to the technology, the problem that a traditional adhesive releases toxic gas in the production and application processes is solved, and an alternative scheme is provided for increasingly deficient fossil resources. Rich bamboo resources in China are utilized, natural lignin and cellulose are adopted as raw materials, and the raw materials are converted into the high-efficiency adhesive through a series of innovative steps. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, mixing bamboo powder or wood powder with a dispersing agent and water to realize full swelling and loosening of raw materials; secondly, performing mechanical treatment, such as a colloid mill or a high-pressure homogenizer, to realize micro-nano treatment of the raw materials so as to obtain smooth paste; and finally, mixing the paste with a modifier and a solvent, and carrying out stirring reaction under specific conditions to prepare the adhesive. According to the adhesive, a dispersing agent and a modifying agent do not need to be removed, and react with lignin in the hot pressing process to form stable chemical bonds, so that the bonding effect is improved.

title: Natural adhesive for carton adhesion
abstract: The invention relates to a natural adhesive for carton adhesion. The bonding strength of the adhesive is improved, and the physicochemical properties of the adhesive is also changed by modifying soybean protein so that the original perishable molecular structure of the adhesive is inactivated, the hydrophobicity of the adhesive is improved, and the adhesive has good corrosion resistance and waterresistance. The storage time and the use performance of the protein adhesive are effectively improved, the adhesive has good bonding capacity for cartons, and the viscosity reaches 1.9 Pa.s or above;preparation raw materials are rich in source, low in price and renewable, harmful gas such as formaldehyde and phenol is not generated in the using process, harm to human health is avoided, environmental pollution is avoided, the problems that an existing protein adhesive is generally poor in corrosion resistance, short in working life and the like are solved, the carton adhesion quality is guaranteed, the carton strength is improved, and large-scale and high-efficiency production can be realized.

title: METHOD FOR FABRICATING NATURAL ADHESIVE USING GARLIC
Waterproof antibacterial bio-base adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a waterproof antibacterial bio-base adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method particularly comprises the following steps: 1-(3-dimethylaminopropyl)3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide are added into an amino-terminated hyperbranched polyester water solution; iconic acid is added, an amination reaction is carried out on the iconic acid with amino groups of the amino-terminated hyperbranched polyester, and then the iconic acid is connected to the end of the amino-terminated hyperbranched polyester; 2,3-epoxypropyltrimethyl ammonium chloride is added, and epoxy groups of the 2,3-epoxypropyltrimethyl ammonium chloride reacts with free carboxyl groups of the iconic acid at the end of the amino-terminated hyperbranched polyester, so that a hyperbranched polyester containing nitrogen positive ions at the end is synthesized; and organosiloxane with double bonds, sodium dodecyl sulfonate and an initiator are added to carry out reacting to obtain the waterproofing antibacterial bio-base adhesive. The adhesive prepared by the method is green and pollution-free and has good waterproof and antibacterial effects, and the preparation method is simple.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE MATERIAL
abstract: An adhesive product and method of making the product replaces asphalt in the manufacture of roofing shingles and pavement. The method comprises steps of forming a mixture of oil comprising fatty acids and a powdered material; maintaining the oil to powdered material weight ratio in the mixture between 1 to 0.01 and 1 to 4.9; heating the mixture to a reaction temperature greater than 100 degrees Centigrade; maintaining the reaction temperature for at least five minutes; and, injecting air into the mixture while maintaining the reaction temperature. In making a roofing shingle, the method includes additional steps of: applying the heated mixture to a fiberglass mat sheet from an upstream roll to form a tacky coated strip; and, adding a layer of granules to the tacky coated strip. The adhesive material of this method comprises polymerized oil and the powdered material.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITION BASED ON LIGNIN
abstract: The present invention relates to an adhesive composition based on a lignin structure, wherein the lignin structure is a lignin functionalised by reaction with dimethylformamide and acrylic acid.

title: BIOBASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF MAKING THE SAME
abstract: An adhesive composition comprising a lignin-based tackifying agent exhibiting a glass transition temperature no greater than 120°C and a thermoplastic polymer.

title: Full-bio-based adhesive and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of adhesives, in particular to a full-bio-based adhesive and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: preparation of demethylated nano-lignin: carrying out nanocrystallization treatment on the demethylated nano-lignin; preparation of oxidized nanocellulose; and preparation of the full-bio-based adhesive: carrying outa pre-crosslinking polymerization reaction on the demethylated nano-lignin suspension, the oxidized nanocellulose suspension and pectin to obtain the full-bio-based adhesive. According to the full-bio-based adhesive and the preparation method thereof provided by the invention, lignin is subjected to demethylation and nanocrystallization treatment, and cellulose is also subjected to nanocrystallization and oxidation treatment. In this way, the reaction efficiency of covalent bonds generated between lignin and cellulose is remarkably improved, the crosslinking degree is improved, the adhesion to a plate is good, and the bonding strength is high. By full-bio-based preparation, the release amount of harmful gases of the obtained adhesive is low, and the reutilization value of the whole plywood is improved through the main components of lignin and cellulose plywood sheets.

title: Modified bio-based adhesive as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a modified bio-based adhesive as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of adhesive preparation. The modified bio-based adhesive is obtained based on modification treatment of a sludge extract, and the modified bio-based adhesive does not release formaldehyde at all in the use process, has high reaction activity with a wood interface, and has very strong cohesive force; the preparation method of the modified bio-based adhesive is simple, and the modified bio-based adhesive has good application in bonding of artificial boards.

title: Bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bio-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof and belongs to the technical field of high-molecular chemistry. The bio-based adhesive contains the following main components in parts by weight: bio-based starch, lignin, tea polyphenol and isocyanate. The bio-based adhesive and the preparation method provided by the invention have the advantages that the traditional preparation method for the adhesives is changed, and under the condition without adding any organic solvent and aldehyde-containing monomer, the bio-based adhesive with higher adhesiveness and heat stability is prepared by adopting natural biomass starch as a main agent, the lignin and the tea polyphenol as additives, the isocyanate as a crosslinking agent and water as a green solvent as well as a series of environment-friendly paths.

title: BIO-ADHESIVES
Water-based bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a water-based bio-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of composite materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing an aqueous solution A containing a cationic polymer and an aqueous solution B containing an anionic polymer, centrifuging, and discarding supernate to obtain an adhesive precursor solution; and mixing a dispersion liquid C containing inorganic particles and an organic cross-linking agent with the adhesive precursor solution to obtain the water-based bio-based adhesive. According to the preparation method, inorganic particles and an organic cross-linking agent are introduced into an adhesive precursor solution, and a large number of physical and chemical cross-linking sites are formed between a cationic polymer and an anionic polymer, so that on one hand, the cohesive strength of the material is greatly improved, and the mechanical interlocking effect between bonding interfaces is enhanced; the bonding effect on wood, glass and steel is obviously improved; on the other hand, water resistance of the material can be enhanced, and interference of a humid environment is effectively resisted.

title: BIOBASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITION, METHOD FOR OBTAINING SAME AND USE THEREOF AS ADHESIVE
abstract: The invention relates to an adhesive composition in the form of a suspension in water of a microfibrillated cellulose complex and at least one branched polysaccharide, with a dry matter content of between 10% and 40% by weight. This composition is obtained by a method comprising: a step of extruding, in a twin-screw extruder, a mixture of water, cellulose fibers and at least one branched polysaccharide, this mixture containing from 10% to 40% by weight of dry matter, and the ratio of the percentages by weight of branched polysaccharide(s) and cellulose in the mixture being between 5/95 and 50/50; and, before or during this extrusion step, a step of enzymatically treating the cellulose fibers by means of a cellulase.

title: Bio-based adhesive as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bio-based adhesive as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The bio-based adhesive comprises caffeic acid, glyoxal, water, sodium hydroxide, a poly (4, 4 '-diphenylmethane diisocyanate) thickening agent, a defoaming agent and a preservative. According to the bio-based formaldehyde-free adhesive disclosed by the invention, the caffeic acid and the glyoxal are taken as matrixes, the glyoxal is added to a phenol ring of the caffeic acid to form cresol, and then the cresol is connected with the phenol ring to form a prepolymer for chain growth to form the adhesive. Sodium hydroxide is used as a base catalyst, and the adhesion strength is improved through a poly (4, 4 '-diphenylmethane diisocyanate) thickener. The adhesive provided by the invention uses bio-based raw materials, can replace petroleum-based raw materials to play a role in phenolic resin production, is a safe and environment-friendly bio-based formaldehyde-free adhesive, and has a great development prospect.

title: Bio-based adhesive for electrical insulation
abstract: The present disclosure is providing a bio-based adhesive composition which is water-based. The adhesive composition includes bioprotein, salt of carboxymethyl cellulose, gum, alkali and a solvent. The adhesive composition is prepared at ambient conditions. The adhesive composition is useful for insulation of the electric material, especially for pressboard for a transformer which requires good adhesive for imparting good mechanical and electrical strength.

title: Underwater bonding of bio-based adhesives
abstract: An underwater binder composition comprising zein and tannic acid, alone or further together with FeCl3, an inorganic filler, a natural polymer, or any combination thereof; and methods of making them.

title: ALGAL BIO-ADHESIVE
abstract: An algal bio-adhesive comprising algae mass, a crosslinking agent and an inorganic filler.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE SYSTEM
abstract: A two-component adhesive system and methods of making and using the same. The adhesive system contains a component (A): a hydroxyl-containing compound and an organic acid amine complex or an aliphatic polyester diaol and a component (B): an aliphatic isocyanate and/or a cycloaliphatic isocyanate. The adhesive composition of the present invention is water-based and has low or is free from volatile organic compounds ("VOC"). The adhesive composition also may be composed of one or more bio-based material totaling from 24% to 95% and may have high solids of over 60% after component A and B are mixed.

title: Low-VOC bio-based adhesive, adhesive tape and preparation method of low-VOC bio-based adhesive
abstract: The invention relates to a low-VOC (volatile organic compound) bio-based adhesive, an adhesive tape and a preparation method of the low-VOC bio-based adhesive. The low-VOC bio-based adhesive comprises the following components in parts by mass: 900-960 parts of bio-based acrylic polymer emulsion; 1-5 parts of a thickening agent; 1-5 parts of a cross-linking agent; 1-6 parts of a wetting agent; 37 to 84 parts of deionized water; the bio-based acrylic polymer emulsion contains a bio-based acrylic polymer, and the bio-based acrylic polymer is obtained by polymerizing raw materials including a bio-based monomer and a non-bio-based monomer; the VOC content of the low-VOC bio-based adhesive is less than or equal to 50 ppm. The low-VOC bio-based adhesive has the advantages of high bio-based content and low VOC content, and is suitable for preparing adhesive tapes with high requirements on physical properties and environmental protection properties.

title: Bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of adhesives, in particular to a bio-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The bio-based adhesive is prepared from the following raw material components: bio-based polyol, bio-based isocyanate and cyclohexane diisocyanate, a tin catalyst, a chain extender and an organic solvent are not contained; the invention also provides a preparation method of the bio-based adhesive, the bio-based adhesive prepared by the invention has good biodegradability, thermoplasticity and biocompatibility, can realize biodegradation under various environmental conditions, reduces pollution to the environment, and is more environment-friendly in treatment after being discarded compared with traditional petroleum-based polyurethane.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention is directed to a bio-based composition comprising a polycondensate of a dimer of a fatty alcohol and a dimer of a fatty acid, and an epoxidized fatty acid ester as a cross-linking agent, wherein the polycondensate and the epoxidized fatty acid ester are capable of reacting with each other. The invention is also directed to an adhesive obtainable by reacting the polycondensate and the epoxidized fatty acid ester, to a method for preparing the adhesive and to the use of the adhesive for laminating a sheet or a film.

title: Bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bio-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof. Inspired by a spider thread structure, biomass adhesive interface enhancement based on a tannic acid adhesion group is combined with construction of a differential phase separation structure by biomass-induced polylipoic acid depolymerization, and a brand new strategy of adhesion-cohesion synergistic enhancement of the adhesive strength of the adhesive is realized. According to the invention, tannic acid and carboxymethyl chitosan are introduced into a lipoic acid-based adhesive, so that the purpose of synergistically enhancing the bonding performance of the adhesive through adhesion-cohesion is achieved, and the defects of weak cohesion, low bonding strength, poor water resistance, poor moisture resistance and the like of the conventional biomass adhesive are overcome. Benefited from a new strategy of adhesion-cohesion synergistic enhancement, the biomass adhesive has good adhesive strength in various environments and materials. In addition, the biomass adhesive also has the characteristics of biological safety, antibacterial and mildew-proof properties and recoverability, so that the product has wider application and potential compared with the previous product, and has a good application prospect.

title: Water-resistant high-adhesion bio-based adhesive
abstract: The invention discloses a water-resistant high-adhesion bio-based adhesive which is prepared by the following steps: by utilizing the unique catechol structure advantage of tea polyphenol, carrying out epoxy modification on the tea polyphenol to prepare a bio-based cross-linking agent, namely tea polyphenol glycidyl ether (TPGE) with both epoxy groups and interfacial activity; and then reacting with malic acid (MAL), ricinoleic acid (RA) and tannic acid (TAN) together to prepare the bio-based adhesive, and the obtained bio-based adhesive has good water resistance and relatively high bonding strength. Therefore, the invention provides a new thought for developing a high-performance bio-based adhesive, expands the application of the natural tea polyphenol derivative in the field of high-performance functional polymers, and has important industrial application prospects.

title: Bio-based adhesive as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a bio-based adhesive as well as a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of adhesives. The invention provides a specific bio-based core-shell flame-retardant particle which is prepared by adding a flame retardant into a mixed solution containing a silane coupling agent and an acid-binding agent, carrying out mixing and modifying to obtain a product A, then mixing tannic acid with the product A, and performing modification. The bio-based core-shell flame-retardant particle is compounded with a composite modifier, soybean protein, a cross-linking agent and water according to a specific ratio to obtain the bio-based adhesive. The bio-based adhesive obtained by the invention is low in production cost, non-toxic and pollution-free, has excellent bonding strength, water resistance and flame retardance, can be used for production and preparation of artificial boards, and has important significance to preparation and application of artificial boards.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE FOR LAMINATE
abstract: The present disclosure provides an adhesive composition. In an embodiment, the adhesive composition includes a reaction product of (A) a bio-based isocyanate component having from 30 wt% to 80 wt% bio-based content comprising (i) an isocyanate-terminated compound, and (ii) an optional first bio-based polyol. The adhesive composition also includes (B) a bio-based polyol component comprising (i) a second bio-based polyol, and (ii) optionally an adhesion promoter. The adhesive composition has greater than 60 wt% of bio-based content.

title: NATURAL ADHESIVE
abstract: The present invention relates to a natural adhesive containing protein and free sugar. The natural adhesive contains allinage and aline. The natural adhesive further contains lectine.

title: Bio-based adhesive for laminating kraft paper to metal plate as well as preparation method and application of bio-based adhesive
abstract: The invention provides a bio-based adhesive for coating kraft paper to a metal plate as well as a preparation method and application of the bio-based adhesive. The adhesive is prepared from the following raw materials: 5 to 50 parts of collagen, 0.6 to 6 parts of amine-rich polymer, 0.5 to 1 part of carboxymethyl cellulose salt, 0.6 to 12 parts of polyphenol substance and 31 to 93.5 parts of water. The adhesive can form stable interface adhesion with kraft paper or a metal plate, ortho-phenolic hydroxyl in polyphenol is subjected to an oxidation reaction to generate a quinoneform structure, and the quinoneform structure and amino in a mixed system are further subjected to a Schiff base reaction, so that cross-linking between heterochain segments and further improvement of cohesion and adhesive force of the adhesive are realized; the adhesive has stronger affinity to kraft paper, and the aqueous characteristic of the adhesive makes colloid more likely to permeate in the kraft paper part and finally wind with kraft paper fibers. The adhesive has the advantages of strong adhesive force, few metal plate part residues, good hygroscopicity, oxidation resistance, easy cleaning, environmental protection, safety and the like.

title: A NATURAL ADHESIVE
abstract: PURPOSE: A natural adhesive is provided to have excellent adhesion, storage and antibacterial performance without any organic compounds. CONSTITUTION: A natural adhesive comprise protein, free sugar, alliinase, and alliin. The protein comprises one or more selected from hydroxy proline, glutamic acid, proline, glycine, alanine, threonine, serine, glycine, alanine, cystine, methionine, isoleucine, leucine, tyrosine, phenylalanine, ethanolamine, ammonia, ornithine, histidine, asparagines, valine, lysine, and arginine. The sugar comprises one or more fructose, glucose, sucrose, and maltose.

title: Cross-linking agent for bio-based adhesive and preparation method of cross-linking agent
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-linking agent for a bio-based adhesive and a preparation method of the cross-linking agent. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out acid amine dehydration condensation reaction on melamine and a binary acid under the condition of 170-190 DEG C to obtain a polycondensed triacid; carrying out dehydration condensation reaction on the polycondensed triacid and a polyethylene polyamine at 160-180 DEG C to obtain an acid amine polycondensation intermediate; dissolving the acid amine polycondensation intermediate in water, regulating the pH value to 7-10, and dropwisely adding epoxy chloropropane at 50-70 DEG C to react, thereby obtaining the cross-linking agent for the bio-based adhesive. When the cross-linking agent is added into the formaldehyde-free albumen glue, the heat curing temperature of protein can be reduced from 130 DEG C or above to 85 DEG C, and meanwhile, the albumen glue is provided with relatively good hot water resistance and adhesion performance.

BIO-ADHESIVE DISSOLVING COMPOUNDS AND DEVICE
abstract: A medical device may comprise a body including a mixture of polyvinylpyrrolidone (“PVP”) and mitomycin. The medical device may be in any size or shape such that the medical device may be inserted into living tissue, including, but not limited to, a lacrimal punctal plug and a stent. The mixture of PVP and mitomycin may be coated on a portion of the medical device, contained within a cavity on the medical device, disposed on the surface of the medical device or configured as part of the medical device such that the mixture of PVP and mitomycin can be delivered to tissue.

title: Bio-adhesives
abstract: Distiller's Grain (DG) based bio-adhesives consisting of DG biomass, crosslinking agents, and fillers are described as substitutes for formaldehyde based wood glue for making wood panels. Algal bio-adhesives consisting of algal biomass, crosslinking agents, and fillers are described as substitutes for formaldehyde based glue for making wood panels. Processes for preparing such DG based bio-adhesives and algal bio-adhesives are provided, comprising the steps of: combining DG biomass or algal material with a cross-linking agent and inorganic fillers to form a blend; micronization or homogenization of the blend to obtain powdery material; and mixing the powdery material with additional water to form a bio-adhesive.

title: Photovoltaic floor containing modified rosin grease bio-based adhesive film
abstract: The invention discloses a photovoltaic floor containing a modified rosin grease bio-based adhesive film, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic building integration, and the photovoltaic floor is formed by laying a first glass plate, a rosin glue solution, a battery piece, a rosin glue solution and a second glass plate in sequence. S1, the rosin glue solution comprises rosin modified thermocuring, and S2, the rosin modified thermocuring comprises the following materials in parts by weight: 50-80 parts of abietic acid and 20-40 parts of glacial acetic acid (gt); and S3, adding 50-80 parts of abietic acid into a 250mL round-bottom flask, arranging a magnetic stirrer, a dropping funnel, an N2 inlet and a thermometer, continuously flushing the round-bottom flask with nitrogen in the whole reaction process, and continuously stirring the round-bottom flask with the nitrogen until the volume of the round-bottom flask is less than 80%, so as to obtain the abietic acid. The method comprises the following steps: heating and stirring 20-40 parts of glacial acetic acid (gt; 80%) until the glacial acetic acid is molten;

title: Bio-based adhesive as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bio-based adhesive as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the bio-based adhesive disclosed by the invention, the biomass matrix comprises a mixture of Arabic gum and carboxymethyl chitosan, a hydrogen bond cross-linked network in the adhesive is formed by utilizing rich carboxyl, hydroxyl and other functional groups of the carboxymethyl chitosan and the Arabic gum, and meanwhile, various macromolecular chains of the polyvinyl alcohol and the reinforcing agent are mutually wound in the adhesive, so that the adhesive has a good adhesive property. Compared with a single biomass-based adhesive, the biomass-based adhesive has the effect of synergistically enhancing the heat resistance, the adhesive strength, the stability and the like of the adhesive; no formaldehyde is added in the preparation process of the adhesive, so that the formaldehyde-free standard is achieved from the source, the operation is simple, and the adhesive is green and environment-friendly; the biomass matrix material is wide in source, rich in natural content and low in price, the solvent of the raw material is water, complex organic modification is not needed, materials harmful to human health are not introduced in the production process, and the biomass matrix material is green and harmless.

title: Natural adhesives and their manufacturing method
abstract: The present invention relates to a natural adhesive and a method for manufacturing the same. More specifically, the present invention relates to a natural adhesive having an effect of neutralizing harmful substances such as formaldehyde and volatile organic compounds, including sargassum horneri powder, which has an effect of adsorbing harmful substances with an adhesive used for manufacturing or finishing a fiber board, and a cypress sap known for antibacterial and deodorizing functions. The method for manufacturing a natural adhesive comprises the steps of: slowly adding 50 to 70 parts by weight of a sargassum horneri solution to 100 parts by weight of an isocyanate resin and stirring the same; adding 15 to 20 parts by weight of a cypress sap to the stirred solution; stirring the mixture at a temperature of 40 to 55 ℃ for 0.5 to 1 hour to completely dissolve the cypress sap; and aging the resulting solution in a low-temperature storage chamber at 10 to 15℃.

title: Natural adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a natural adhesive and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of application of natural non-synthetic materials. According to the invention, natural fresh tung tree fruit extruded liquid is taken as a core, and water, a thickening agent and an emulsifier are added to improve the performance of the glue. According to the natural adhesive disclosed by the invention, the raw materials for preparing the natural adhesive are cheap, the immature green tung tree fruits are fully utilized, and the prepared natural adhesive has the characteristics of high viscosity, good adhesion, greenness, environmental protection and the like.

title: Bio-based Adhesive Composition Based on Lignin
abstract: The present invention relates to an adhesive composition based on a lignin structure, wherein the lignin structure is a lignin functionalised by reaction with dimethylformamide and acrylic acid.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE MATERIAL
abstract: An adhesive product and method of making the product replaces asphalt in the manufacture of roofing shingles and pavement. The method comprises steps of forming a mixture of oil comprising fatty acids and a powdered material; maintaining the oil to powdered material weight ratio in the mixture between 1 to 0.01 and 1 to 4.9; heating the mixture to a reaction temperature greater than 100 degrees Centigrade; maintaining the reaction temperature for at least five minutes; and, injecting air into the mixture while maintaining the reaction temperature. In making a roofing shingle, the method includes additional steps of: applying the heated mixture to a fiberglass mat sheet from an upstream roll to form a tacky coated strip; and, adding a layer of granules to the tacky coated strip. The adhesive material of this method comprises polymerized oil and the powdered material.

title: Keratin bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a keratin-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: 1) dissolving keratin powder in water to prepare a keratin aqueous solution; 2) adding an oxidizing reagent into the aqueous solution for modification, and stirring for a period of time at a certain temperature; and 3) freeze-drying the modified mixed solution into powder, and then adding a certain amount of diluent to obtain the keratin bio-based adhesive. Compared with an existing adhesive, the keratin-based adhesive is prepared by utilizing the interaction of functional groups of oxidation modified keratin, belongs to a bio-based adhesive, and is renewable, degradable and environment-friendly.

title: ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING BIO-BASED ADHESIVES AND MIXTURES FOR CURTAIN COATING
BIOBASED ADHESIVE MIXTURE AND THE USE OF SAID ADHESIVE MIXTURE
abstract: The present invention relates to adhesive mixtures. In particular, the invention concerns the use of lignin in biobased hot-melt (non-pressure sensitive) and pressure sensitive adhesives, as well as novel adhesive mixtures suitable for use as such adhesives. The adhesive mixture comprises 25-85 wt-% lignin, 10-75 wt-% plasticizer, 0-50 wt-% tackifier and 0-40 wt-% waxes, by solid weight. The combined amount of lignin, plasticizer, tackifier and waxes is at least 90 wt-%, by solid weight, of the adhesive mixture.

abstract: Underwater adhesive compositions comprising a zein and a tannic acid, alone or further in combination with FeCl3, an inorganic filler, a natural polymer, or any combination thereof; and a method of making them.

title: Bio-based adhesive composition for nonwoven materials
abstract: The present invention relates to a bio-based adhesive composition that is environmentally friendly, renewable, compostable and/or biodegradable. A bio-based composition includes chitosan, an acid, and a plasticizer. By treating a nonwoven material with the bio-based adhesive according to the present invention, it is possible to provide a nonwoven material exhibiting excellent mechanical properties. The adhesive compositions according to the present invention are readily useful for treating different types of nonwoven materials, and can be adapted to provide certain properties to certain nonwoven materials and applications.

abstract: The present invention is directed to a bio-based composition comprising a polycondensate of a dimer of a fatty alcohol and a dimer of a fatty acid, and an epoxidized fatty acid ester as a cross-linking agent, wherein the polycondensate and the epoxidized fatty acid ester are capable of reacting with each other. abstract: The present invention describes novel formaldehyde-free adhesive compositions, adhesive mixtures comprising said adhesive composition (component A) and at least one hardener agent (component B), and adhesive systems wherein the adhesive composition further comprising a thickener agent (component A) and the at least one hardener agent (component B) are isolated one of another. Said adhesive compositions, mixtures and systems may be used for curtain coating of a substrate and, in particular, for plywood manufacturing by curtain coating. The present invention also relates to a process for manufacturing a coated material by applying the adhesive mixture by curtain coating, to coated products, in particular plywood, obtainable or obtained by said process and to coated products, or plywood comprising the adhesive composition or mixture of the invention.

abstract: A bio-based adhesive and method of making the adhesive replaces or serves as additives for asphalt, sealant, and polymers such as styrene-butadiene-styrene and atactic polypropylene in the manufacture of building or paving materials. The method includes steps of forming a mixture of oil comprising fatty acids group and optionally a powdered material; maintaining the oil-to-powdered-material weight ratio in the mixture between 1 to 0.00001 and 1 to 20; heating the mixture to a reaction temperature greater than 55 degrees Centigrade; maintaining the reaction temperature until the oil is polymerized; and, injecting air into the mixture while polymerizing the oil. The adhesive of this method comprises a renewable polymer and the powdered material.

title: Natural adhesive
abstract: The invention discloses a natural adhesive which is prepared from protein glue, fish oil, emulsion glue and polyisoprene in a weight ratio of (2-7):(1-3):(4-6):(1-2). The natural adhesive has the advantages that natural biological raw materials are used, and conventional aldehyde-containing glue is completely replaced, so that no formaldehyde can be released, the natural adhesive is applicable to processing on shaving boards and is excellent in adhesion strength and nail-holding power and good in mechanical processing property.

title: Water-resistant bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a water-resistant bio-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof, which belongs to the technical field of a high-molecular material. The water-resistant bio-based adhesivecomprises the following main components in parts by weight: 30-100 parts of starch, 6-9 parts of spherical lignosulfonate, 1-4 parts of tea polyphenol, 0.5-2 parts of an initiator, 20-40 parts of isocyanate, and 1-10 parts of hyperbranched polyester. The water-resistant bio-based adhesive takes natural biomass starch as a main agent, spherical lignosulfonate and tea polyphenol as an additive, isocyanate as a crosslinking agent, and hyperbranched polyester as a water resistance enhancer, the prepared bio-based adhesive does not contain formaldehyde, and has high adhesion, thermal stability andwater resistance.

title: NATURAL ADHESIVE AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The present invention provides a natural adhesive comprising a milk protein and a manufacturing method therefor. According to the present invention, the natural adhesive can be manufactured relatively easily using materials that are easily available in the vicinity, without a need to perform a special process. Furthermore, the present invention can provide the so-called 'eco-friendly' natural adhesive consisting of ingredients, which do not harm the human body while implementing strong adhesion and water resistance, and a manufacturing method therefor.

title: BIOBASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITONS
abstract: The present invention relates to biobased adhesive compositions. More particularly, the present invention relates to adhesive compositions, the processes for manufacturing same and the applications thereof, in particular in the form of wood particle board. The invention relates in particular to an adhesive composition in the form of a solution or dispersion comprising at least one water-soluble or water-dispersible polysaccharide comprising aldehyde functions, said solution or dispersion having a solids content of greater the 20 wt%, preferably of at least 30 wt% and more preferably of at least 40 wt%, expressed as a weight percentage of solids relative to the total weight of the solution or dispersion.

title: HEAT RESISTANT BIO-ADHESIVES
abstract: An adhesive material produced by contacting a catechol with an amine may be stable under heated conditions and produce minimal outgassing under vacuum. The catechol may be an un-substituted catechol or a substituted catechol, such as hydroxychavicol. In some examples, the catechol may be derived from botanical sources. The amine may be a diamine, such as phenylene diamine. The adhesive polymer may form dendritic structures or macrocyclic structures. A joined article may be fabricated from two materials by applying the adhesive to a prepared surface of at least one of the materials, and the two materials may be placed together with the adhesive between them. The adhesive in the joined article may be cured at ambient temperature or under heating conditions.

title: UNSATURATED PHOTO-CURABLE BIO-BASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention provides a composition comprising an unsaturated polycondensate comprising a component with at least one carbon-carbon double bond and at least two carboxylic acid groups or the respective diester derivatives, preferably itaconic acid or an itaconic acid diester, in combination with a diol or a dimer of a fatty alcohol and a diacid monomer different from the first mentioned component; and a component chosen from a tackifying resin and/or a low-Tg polyester polyol, and/or a plasticizer; wherein the unsaturated polycondensate is capable of being cured via a radical mechanism. The invention is also directed at an environment-friendly adhesive comprising said composition, at a method for preparing the adhesive and at the use of the adhesive for laminating a sheet or a film.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE FOR ELECTRICAL INSULATION
Plywood bio-adhesive and preparation method for same
abstract: The invention discloses a plywood bio-adhesive and a preparation method for the same. The plywood bio-adhesive is prepared from the following formula components in parts by mass: 5 to 15 parts of ethyl acrylate, 16 to 18 parts of dimethylamine, 5 to 15 parts of butyl acrylate, 2 to 6 parts of an emulsifier, 8 to 10 parts of diethylenetriamine, 12 to 14 parts of poly-ketoamine, 6 to 8 parts of triethylenetetramine, 13 to 15 parts of butyl methacrylate, 14 to 16 parts of polyethylene imine, 2 to 4 parts of a drier, 15 to 17 parts of glycidyl acrylate and 30 to 50 parts of ammonia water. The obtained adhesive has adhesion strength of an I typed adhesive, is free of formaldehyde and low in cost, and has high industrial popularization value, and the water resistance of an adhesive layer is improved.

title: Bio-based adhesive as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a bio-based adhesive as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The bio-based adhesive is prepared from the following raw materials: a quaternary ammonium salt compound and a polyphenol compound. The bio-based adhesive has super-strong bonding strength to various materials, the bonding strength to glass is 0.41-8.15 MPa, the bonding strength to stainless steel is 0.35-8.11 MPa, the bonding strength to ceramic is 0.45-14.41 MPa, the bio-based adhesive is excellent in reusability, the bonding strength is not greatly reduced after the bio-based adhesive is repeatedly used for five times, the bio-based adhesive is excellent in organic solvent resistance, and the bio-based adhesive can be applied to various materials. And after long-term soaking in an organic solvent, relatively high bonding strength is still maintained.

abstract: The present invention relates to a natural adhesive, a natural adhesive for an interior material comprising the natural adhesive, a natural paint comprising the natural adhesive, and a construction method using the natural adhesive for an interior material and the natural paint, wherein the natural adhesive includes plantain extract, slippery elm extract, abelmoschus manihot extract, lotus extract, and visible vine extract.

title: BIO-ADHESIVE AND WOOD BOARD
abstract: The invention relates to a bio-adhesive. In accordance with the invention, the bio-adhesive is formed by reaction, selected from the group of esterification, condensation and their combinations, of natural based binder material containing active groups with a reactant having reactive groups capable of forming bonds with -OH and/or -NH2 groups of the binder material. Further, the invention relates to a wood board in which veneers are glued by the bio-adhesive.

title: BIOBASED ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF MAKING THE SAME
abstract: An adhesive composition comprising a lignin-based tackifying agent exhibiting a glass transition temperature no greater than 120°C and a thermoplastic polymer.

title: Degradable water-based bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of adhesives, in particular to a degradable water-based bio-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The water-based bio-based adhesive is prepared from the following components: 30 to 40 parts of polyether glycol, 40 to 50 parts of lysine diisocyanate, 1 to 5 parts of dibutyltin dilaurate, 40 to 60 parts of dimethyl succinate, 0.5 to 2 parts of organic bismuth catalyst, 40 to 60 parts of 1, 4-butanediol, 1 to 3 parts of tetrabutyl titanate, 5 to 10 parts of dimethylolpropionic acid, 20 to 30 parts of tannic acid, 6 to 10 parts of filler, 3 to 6 parts of antioxidant and 20 to 30 parts of deionized water. According to the adhesive disclosed by the invention, polyether glycol and lysine diisocyanate react to generate polyurethane, and dimethyl succinate can react with 1, 4-butanediol to generate poly (butylene succinate), so that a copolymer of polyurethane and poly (butylene succinate) is formed, and the adhesive has high bonding strength and good biodegradability at the same time; the pollution of the adhesive to the environment is reduced.

title: High-strength bio-based adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength bio-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof. The nano-crystalline cellulose adhesive comprises nano-crystalline cellulose, an adhesive active component and an auxiliary component. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, mixing lignin and tannin, and adding water; adjusting the pH value of the mixture, and reacting under a first temperature condition; secondly, adding a glyoxal solution, reacting under a second temperature condition, and filtering a reaction product after the reaction is finished to obtain a mixture of glyoxal lignin and tannin; then adding nanocellulose, and uniformly stirring at a certain rotating speed to obtain a nanocellulose-containing adhesive system; finally, hexylamine and starch are added into the nano-cellulose-containing adhesive system for curing treatment, and the high-strength bio-based adhesive is obtained after curing. After the nano cellulose is stably dispersed in water, a dispersion liquid with high viscosity can be formed, and the nano cellulose is adopted as an adhesive component, so that the adhesive strength of the adhesive can be enhanced, and the tensile strength of the adhesive can also be improved.

title: Full-bio-based adhesive prepared from beans as raw material as well as preparation method and application of full-bio-based adhesive
abstract: The invention discloses a full-bio-based adhesive prepared from beans and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of adhesives, the full-bio-based adhesive comprises the following raw materials by weight: 100 parts of water, 10-20 parts of powdery soybean protein substances, 2-5 parts of a bio-based cross-linking agent, 1-3 parts of tannic acid, and 0.1-2 parts of phytic acid. The invention also provides a preparation method which comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing the water, the powdery soybean protein substance and the dispersing agent, adjusting the pH value to 10-11, then adding the tannic acid and the phytic acid, adding the cross-linking agent, continuously heating and stirring, finally adding the defoaming agent and the bacteriostatic agent, and uniformly stirring to obtain the adhesive. The adhesive prepared by the method can effectively form a compact cross-linked structure after being applied to bamboo wood, wood, plywood and other materials and subjected to hot pressing treatment, has the advantages of high dry/wet strength, good water resistance, low carbon, environment friendliness, no wastewater or toxic and irritant gas in the production process, low processing temperature, biodegradability and the like, and has a wide application prospect.

title: Artificial board material containing natural adhesive
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial board material containing a natural adhesive. The artificial board material containing the natural adhesive is prepared from, by weight part, 10-20 parts of corn cobs, 1-4 parts of melon seed shells, 30-40 parts of board leftovers, 2-6 parts of calcium carbonate, 3-5 parts of modifying compound powder and 10-20 parts of the adhesive. The obtained artificial board material contains the core cobs and the melon seed shells, the corn cobs have certain pores, the volume weight can be reduced, the heat-preserving effect can be improved, and meanwhile a certain sound insulation effect is achieved; and due to use of the melon seed shells, waste is turned into wealth, the volume weight is reduced, the modification compound weight is increased and well compatible with the rest of raw materials, the defects of the corn cobs and the melon seed shells are overcome, and the strength of the artificial board material is improved.

title: BIO-BASED ADHESIVE COMPRISING YEAST PROTEIN EXTRACTS FROM LIQUID INDUSTRIAL WASTE FROM THE BREWING AND BREAD INDUSTRIES, REINFORCED WITH NANOLIGNIN AND AT LEAST ONE CROSS-LINKING AGENT, USEFUL FOR THE PRODUCTION OF PARTICLE BOARD (PB), PLYWOOD (PW) AND ORIENTED STRAND BOARD (OSB)
abstract: The invention relates to a bio-based adhesive for the sustainable production of particle board (PB), plywood (PW) and oriented strand board (OSB). The adhesive according to the invention is protein-based and comprises a yeast protein extract from yeast from liquid industrial waste from the brewing industry or a mixture of yeast protein extracts from yeast from liquid industrial waste from the brewing and bread industries, and it is reinforced with nanolignin and at least one cross-linking agent, which can be selected from resorcinol, glyoxal, diphenylmethane diisocyanate, glutaraldehyde, melamine, lignosulfonate or a mixture thereof. The invention also relates to a preparation method for said adhesive and the production of said boards.

title: Curved-surface photovoltaic tile prepared by adopting bio-based adhesive film and preparation method of curved-surface photovoltaic tile
abstract: The invention discloses a curved-surface photovoltaic tile prepared by adopting a bio-based adhesive film and a preparation method of the curved-surface photovoltaic tile, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic building integration. S1, preparing curved glass; s2, preparing an acrylate adhesive film; s3, photovoltaic tile integration preparation; the preparation method of the acrylate adhesive film comprises the following steps: 1, preparing raw materials; 2, stirring and mixing; 3, polymerization reaction; 4, removing impurities; and 5, mold forming. The curved-surface photovoltaic tile is prepared by adopting the acrylate adhesive film, the biocompatibility is high, the degradability is good, compared with a traditional petroleum-based vinyl adhesive film, the influence on the environment is small in the production and use process, and compared with a traditional plane photovoltaic tile, the curved-surface photovoltaic tile can better utilize sunlight, and the sunlight utilization rate is high. Due to the low water permeability and oxygen permeability of the bio-based adhesive film, the stability and integrity of the structure of the curved-surface photovoltaic tile can be kept under the severe weather condition, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the photovoltaic tile is further improved through the acrylate adhesive film.

title: MODIFIED GUAYULE RESIN/SOY PROTEIN BLENDS FOR BIO-BASED ADHESIVES, ASSOCIATED METHODS FOR FORMING SAME, AND ASSOCIATED STRUCTURES INCLUDING SUCH ADHESIVES
High-strength and water-resistant bio-based adhesive as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention designs a high-strength and water-resistant bio-based adhesive as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of bio-based adhesives in high polymer materials. The bio-based adhesive disclosed by the invention is a compact solid and comprises the following raw material components: bio-based polyphenol, a modifying reagent 1, a modifying reagent 2 and a modifying reagent 3. The preparation method of the bio-based adhesive comprises the following steps: uniformly stirring bio-based polyphenol and a modifying reagent 1, reacting at a certain temperature, and separating and purifying to obtain a product 1; uniformly stirring a modifying reagent 2 and a modifying reagent 3, adding a proper amount of water and hydrochloric acid, reacting at a certain temperature, and separating and purifying to obtain a product 2; and uniformly mixing the product 1 and the product 2 to obtain the bio-based adhesive with excellent performance. The bio-based adhesive provided by the invention has the advantages of environmental protection, degradability, high bonding strength, good water resistance, low curing cost and the like.

title: A Composite of Bio-natural adhesive by using Fructan from Microbes
abstract: The present invention provides a composition of a bio-natural adhesive, which does not contain volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and the like and volatile gases are not emitted although excellent adhesion ability is obtained, and especially, which contains a Levan glue solution, a starch solution and a natural mineral having excellent environmental friendliness and human harmlessness since ammonia gas does not dissipate.

title: A FUNCTIONAL PAPER BOX USING A NATURAL ADHESIVE
abstract: The present invention relates to a high-functional packing material using a natural adhesive and, more specifically, to a high-functional packing material using a natural adhesive, which prevents harmful materials from being exhausted by bonding the packing materials to be manufactured to each other using a natural adhesive. The high-functional packing material is bonded using an adhesion composition comprising a natural adhesive, which includes elements extracted from garlic, and a functional inorganic material.

title: ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING BIO-BASED ADHESIVES, AND THEIR USE FOR MANUFACTURING WOOD-BASED COMPOSITES AND FIBREGLASS OR ROCK WOOL INSULATIONS
ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING BIO-BASED ADHESIVES FROM RENEWABLE RESOURCES, AND THEIR USE FOR MANUFACTURING PLYWOOD
abstract: The present invention refers to novel formaldehyde-free bio-based adhesive compositions, adhesive systems comprising, isolated one of another, said adhesive composition (component A) and at least one hardener agent (component B), and adhesive mixtures comprising the adhesive composition and the hardener agent. These adhesive compositions, systems and mixtures can be used for plywood manufacturing.

title: PRODUCTS COMPRISING AT LEAST ONE SYNTHETIC-RUBBER PRESSURE-SENSITIVE ADHESIVE COMPRISING BIO-BASED ADHESIVE RESINS AND PRODUCTION PROCESS FOR THESE
abstract: Pressure-sensitive adhesive comprising at least one synthetic rubber based on at least one vinylaromatic (A) and at least one diene (B); the proportion of synthetic rubber being at most 45% by weight; at least one bio-based adhesive resin based to an extent of at least 85% on renewable raw materials and making up a proportion of at least 1% by weight to at most 25% by weight of the entire composition of the pressure-sensitive adhesive.

title: NATURAL ADHESIVE USING GARLIC AND FABRICATING METHOD OF THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a natural adhesive using garlic and a fabricating method thereof, and, more particularly to a very preservative, adhesive, nonpoisonous and high-performance natural adhesive, which is a chemical-free natural adhesive using garlic with high antibiosis as a major ingredient, capable of efficiently preventing a variety of damages due to volatile organic compounds by employing no chemicals throughout the whole fabricating procedures, and a fabricating method thereof. In detail, the present invention provides a natural adhesive using garlic fabricated by filtering and concentrating an extracted liquid obtained from a mixture of pulverized garlic and water. In addition, the present invention provides a method of fabricating a natural adhesive using garlic, including: (a) preparing and pulverizing garlic; (b) adding a solvent into the pulverized garlic; (c) extracting an extracted liquid from a mixture of the pulverized garlic and water; (d) filtering the extracted liquid; and (e) concentrating the filtered extracted liquid.

title: Algal Bio-adhesives: Compositions, Process for Manufacturing, Formulations and Uses
abstract: Algal bio-adhesives consisting of algae biomass, crosslinking agents, and fillers, and optionally with other additives to form aqueous bio-adhesives as substitutes of formaldehyde based glue for wood panel process are disclosed. The algal bio-adhesives can also be used for other purposes such as biomedical, marine, and automotive industrial applications. There is also provided a process for preparing such algal bio-adhesives which comprising the steps of: a) combining algal material, a cross-linking agent and inorganic fillers to form a blend by mechanical blender; b) micronising the blend to obtain powdery material and c) mixing the powdery material with water, optionally with the addition of other additives such as defoaming agent, thickener, wet strength agent and another crosslinking agent to form algae based bio-adhesives.

title: Special high-transparency natural adhesive for cigars and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a special high-transparency natural adhesive for cigars and a preparation method of the special high-transparency natural adhesive. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing powder, mixing, preparing glue, swelling and homogenizing. Konjac glucomannan and A-type Arabic gum are used as main materials, good thickening property, biological activity and synergistic interaction of KGM and GA are utilized, beta-cyclodextrine is used as an auxiliary material, and the special high-transparency natural adhesive for cigars, which is excellent in comprehensive performance, moderate in viscosity, relatively good in transparency and relatively high in stability, is prepared. And the problems of white marks, peculiar smell, easiness in mildewing and the like in the use process of the traditional CMC adhesive for cigars can be well solved. The raw materials are natural, green, healthy and low in price, the preparation process is simple and environment-friendly, the storage time can be prolonged by utilizing the characteristic that konjac glucomannan has natural antibiotics, the effect of preventing mildew is achieved to a certain extent, no preservative is added, the nutritional ingredients and sensory quality of the cigar finished product are not influenced, and the cigar is suitable for large-scale production. High-end Chinese cigars are brought to vast consumers, and safety and health are also brought.

abstract: An adhesive composition for use in coupling together two substrates to form a structure, such as for use in coupling together two wooden substrates to form a wooden structure, includes a mixture of a modified guayule resin and soy protein. The modified guayule resin can be a base- solvent modified guayule resin or can be an HiCh-modified guayule resin each respectively formed from an unmodified guayule base resin. The unmodified guayule base resin is obtained in a rubber extraction process of guayule at solvent removal temperatures ranging from 104 to 166 degrees Celsius. The method for forming the adhesive composition includes forming a modified guayule resin and mixing the formed modified guayule resin with soy protein. The adhesive composition, when used in forming structures, provides enhanced wet shear strength as compared with adhesive compositions including soy protein alone.

abstract: Distiller's Grain (DG) based bio-adhesives consisting of DG biomass, cross linking agents and fillers is disclosed. There is also provided a process to manufacture such DG bio-adhesives which comprising the steps of : A) blending DG biomass, a cross-linking agent and inorganic fillers to form a blend by mechanical blender; B) micronisation or homogenization of the blend to obtain powdery material and C) mixing the powdery material with additional water, optionally with the addition of other additives such as defoaming agent, thickener, wet-strength agent and another cross linking agent to form DG based bio-adhesives. The DG bio-adhesives can also be used in environmentally friendly construction and packaging industry.

title: Sheet Formation of natural adhesive sheet for wood based on resin powder and glutinous rice powder and its preparation method
abstract: The present invention relates to a natural adhesive sheet composition for wood and a method of manufacturing the same. More particularly, the present invention relates to a method of manufacturing a natural adhesive sheet, wherein, in order to make a natural adhesive aqueous solution for easy deposition, grains such as glutinous rice, corn, and wheat are boiled with Ulmus cortex to make a natural liquid adhesive, and a wet web having a thickness of 0.01 to 0.2 mm is generated through a process of a paper part such as a paper material control unit, a paper material pressing unit, and a wet web thickness control unit for deposited paper materials in the natural adhesive aqueous solution. In order to be able to apply a rosin powder and glutinous rice powder to the wet web at a basis weight of 150 to 200 g/m^2, the rosin powder and glutinous rice powder are pulverized into particles having a size of 300 to 1,000 mesh, and the wet web is dried at a temperature of 30 to 50°C so that the resin powder and glutinous rice powder applied on the wet web do not melt or cooked by the heat imposed upon drying the wet web.

title: Composite anti-corrosion and anti-mildew agent for bio-based adhesive and preparation method of composite anti-corrosion and anti-mildew agent
abstract: The invention discloses a composite anti-corrosion and anti-mildew agent for a bio-based adhesive and a preparation method of the composite anti-corrosion and anti-mildew agent. The preparation methodcomprises the following steps: taking 100 parts of a silicate, 40-60 parts of calcium oxide, 4-6 parts of zinc oxide, 2-3 parts of copper oxide, 0.5-1 part of silver oxide and 240-260 parts of boraxas raw materials, mixing the raw materials with water to obtain a pretreated material, carrying out wet grinding on the pretreated material to obtain a slurry, dehydrating and washing the slurry, andcarrying out centrifugal separation to obtain a solid material, and drying the solid material to obtain the composite anti-corrosion and anti-mildew agent. The main active component is boron; the auxiliary active components are zinc, copper and silver elements, the non-active component is calcium elements, borate formed through reaction has low water solubility, high thermal stability and the like, and meanwhile, based on the synergistic effect of B-Zn-Cu-Ag composite components, the corrosion-resistant and mildew-proof effects can be achieved when a small amount of the composite anti-corrosion and anti-mildew agent is used in the bio-based adhesive.

title: Antistatic plant-based adhesive tape for aviation and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an antistatic plant-based adhesive tape for aviation. The antistatic plant-based adhesive tape for aviation includes an antistatic layer, a substrate layer and an adhesive layer which are stacked in order. The antistatic layer comprises, by weight, 0.3-0.5 part of conductive carbon fibers, 10-30 parts of polyethylene and 20-40 parts of an ethylene-acrylic acid copolymer. Inthe antistatic plant-based adhesive tape for aviation, the surface of the substrate layer is provided with the antistatic layer, the antistatic layer contains the conductive carbon fibers, and the conductive carbon fibers are dispersed in the polyethylene and ethylene-acrylic acid copolymer and firmly adhered to the substrate layer through the polyethylene and ethylene-acrylic acid copolymer, thereby preventing electrostatic from enriching on the plant-based adhesive tape, which affects the use safety of the plant-based adhesive tape. Furthermore, since the conductive carbon fibers have the characteristics of high strength and light weight, when the antistatic layer is formed on the substrate, the conductive carbon fibers can enhance the strength of the plant-based adhesive tape, and further improves the application range and use safety of the plant-based adhesive tape.

Closed-loop recyclable solvent-free bio-based adhesive as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a closed-loop recoverable solvent-free bio-based adhesive as well as a preparation method and application thereof, a covalent cross-linked reusable solvent-resistant bio-based adhesive is successfully synthesized by taking lipoic acid and tris (2-aminoethyl) amine as a basis, carrying out condensation reaction between carboxyl and amino and taking tris (2-aminoethyl) amine as a cross-linking agent; the specific operation process comprises the steps that lipoic acid and tris (2-aminoethyl) amine are mixed and then stirred for 2 hours at the temperature of 100-150 DEG C, reversible covalent amido bonds are used for synthesizing the closed-loop recyclable solvent-free bio-based adhesive, and the mass ratio of tris (2-aminoethyl) amine to lipoic acid is (0.2-1): 1. The adhesive disclosed by the invention has excellent shear strength, solvent resistance and reutilization performance, can be subjected to closed-loop chemical recovery, and shows multiple potentials of practical application.

title: Preparation method and application of reinforcing and toughening bio-based adhesive based on double dynamic covalent bonds
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bio-based formaldehyde-free adhesives, and aims to provide a preparation method and application of a high-strength and high-toughness bio-based adhesive. Through interface molecular structure design, a boron nitride nanosheet based on sulfydryl click chemical function modification is constructed, an interface mechanical interlocking and chemical multi-network cross-linking reinforcing and toughening integrated technology is innovated, and the preparation method of the boron nitride nanosheet intercalation modified reinforcing and toughening plant protein adhesive is provided. The characteristic of poor interfacial adhesion between the adhesive and the wood surface is obviously improved, and the bio-based adhesive with good water resistance, high strength, excellent toughness and wider application range is obtained. According to the present invention, the dry shear strength of the plywood prepared by using the high-performance, high-strength and high-toughness bio-based adhesive through hot pressing can achieve 2.56 MPa, the wet shear strength can achieve 1.32 MPa, the wet debonding work can achieve 1800 mJ, excellent strength and excellent toughness can be represented, the thermal stability and the fire resistance of the adhesive can be significantly enhanced, and the wide industrial application prospect can be provided.

title: Preparation method of high-strength, recoverable and repairable rapid light-curing bio-based adhesive
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-strength, recoverable and repairable rapid light-curing bio-based adhesive, which comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing a high-strength, recoverable, repairable and rapid light-curing bio-based adhesive; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving cellulose, 2-(tert-butylamino) ethyl methacrylate, diisocyanate and a catalyst in a good solvent according to a certain molar ratio, and reacting at 40-100 DEG C for 2-8 hours to prepare a cellulose-based macromonomer containing dynamic steric hindrance urea bonds; and 2, dissolving the cellulose-based macromonomer, metacrylic acid ester and a photoinitiator in a good solvent according to a certain mass ratio, pouring the solution into a mold, and after the solvent is volatilized, carrying out ultraviolet curing for 1-10 minutes to prepare the high-strength, recoverable and repairable rapid photocuring bio-based adhesive. According to the preparation method, the green, environment-friendly, high-strength, recoverable and repairable rapid light-curing bio-based adhesive can be simply, conveniently and efficiently prepared.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A PLANT-BASED ADHESIVE WITH REDUCED T2/HT2 CONTENT
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren zur Herstellung eines pflanzenbasierten Klebers mit einem reduzierten Gehalt an T-2-Toxin (T2) und/oder HT-2-Toxin (HT2), umfassend die Schritte: (a) Bereitstellung eines Ausgangsmaterials, das T2 und/oder HT2 enthält, (b) alkalische Behandlung des Ausgangsmaterials bei einem pH-Wert von 9,0 oder darüber, wobei der Gehalt an T2 und/oder HT2 um 50 Gew% oder mehr reduziert wird, (c) Einstellung des pH-Werts des alkalisch behandelten Ausgangsmaterials auf 7,5 oder darunter, und (d) Fertigstellung des pflanzenbasierten Klebers. Die Erfindung betrifft auch einen pflanzenbasierten Kleber, erhältlich durch dieses Verfahren, einen Gehalt an T2 und/oder HT2 von 500 ppb oder darunter, und eine Stickstofflöslichkeit von 1,0 Gew% oder darüber, sowie die Verwendung des pflanzenbasierten Klebers in der Futtermittelindustrie und/oder in der Nahrungsmittelindustrie.
